help.tmdb:
Open themoviedb.org and register (free, no card needed).
Go to your profile: Settings → API.
Choose “Developer” and fill in the short form — the app name can be anything, state personal use as the purpose.
Copy the “API Key (v3 auth)” field — a 32-character string.
help.gemini:
Open aistudio.google.com/apikey with a Google account.
Press “Create API key” and pick (or create) a project.
Copy the key — it starts with AIza.
You can leave the model field empty: the default gemini-3.5-flash will be used.
help.rawg:
Register at rawg.io.
Open rawg.io/apidocs and press “Get API key”.
Fill in the form — the app name and address can be anything (a personal site works).
The key appears on your profile's API page — copy it.
help.igdb:
Sign in at dev.twitch.tv/console/apps with a Twitch account (two-factor authentication is required).
Press “Register Your Application”: any name, OAuth Redirect URL http://localhost, category Application Integration.
Copy the Client ID.
Press “New Secret” and copy the Client Secret — it is shown only once.
help.serpapi:
Register at serpapi.com.
Open serpapi.com/manage-api-key.
Copy “Your Private API Key”.
help.serper:
Register at serper.dev with a Google account.
The key is on the dashboard right away (“API Key”) — copy it.
help.youtube:
Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project.
APIs & Services → Library → find “YouTube Data API v3” and enable it.
APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → API key.
Copy the key.
help.telegram:
In Telegram find @BotFather and send /newbot.
Give the bot a name, then a username — it must end in bot.
BotFather replies with the token (123456:ABC-DEF…) — copy it and paste it here.
Write something to your own bot (even “hi”) — until you do, it cannot message you.
To find the chat id open https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates and copy the chat.id number.

helpNote.tmdb: Free, and it does not ask for a card.
helpNote.gemini: Free tier: ~15 requests per minute and 1500 per day. No card needed.
helpNote.rawg: Free up to 20,000 requests a month.
helpNote.igdb: Free, but both values are required — OAuth does not work with only one.
helpNote.serpapi: The free plan is 250 searches a month and the budget belongs to the whole account.
helpNote.serper: You get 2500 free credits on signup; every requested page costs one credit.
helpNote.youtube: Free (10,000 units a day). Without it the video title and thumbnail still arrive.
helpNote.telegram: Completely free. The token is full access to the bot — do not share it.
